quest.title: Commence! A Suspect Genesis
quest.description: The King of Invokations Grand Prix is underway! Unbeknownst to all, however, there is an even more startling event hiding in its shadow...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Invokation Coupons x100, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Eichendorff
dialogues.text: *sigh* What a disaster — I didn't even make it through the qualifiers! How'd you do?

dialogues.speaker: Lennard
dialogues.text: I didn't do any better... I was beaten by that little Timmie kid.

dialogues.speaker: Lennard
dialogues.text: I've only ever seen him out there feeding pigeons... No clue how he got to be such a good card player.

dialogues.speaker: Eichendorff
dialogues.text: The next round's starting soon, right? Let's head over and watch the matches. I'm curious to see who'll win the grand prize.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you hear that? A grand prize!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like they were talking about a card competition. They must be talking about Genius Invokation TCG!

choices.text: A Genius Invokation tournament, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Should be! But let's go ask Diona for details!

choices.text: Do you think there'll be any tasty food at the venue?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Wh—Wha... Am I seeing double!? Do you have TWO tails!?
Your eyes are working just fine — yes, I have two tails. You wanna pet them?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Wow... Um... Does it hurt where your tail splits into two? Which one did you grow first? Oh, and what do you do when they start moving around while you're asleep?
Oh... Well, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Oh, ah... sorry if those were tricky questions. I've just never seen anyone with two tails before!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who's Diona chatting with? Hmm, from her outfit... Paimon would guess she's probably from Inazuma.
Hehe, aw, don't worry, kid! I'm sure you'll be growing a couple of tails of your own in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Huh? ...You think I can grow two tails as well?
Sure! You're a youkai too, right? Your youkai power must be really strong if you can already take on human form.
I was just climbing a tree one day when another tail popped out, just like that. People started calling me a... um, a "nekomata," I think?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Youkai? Nekomata? ...Ah, no, no, no, you've got it all wrong. My ears and tail are part of my Kätzlein bloodline.
Oh. So... you're not a Mondstadt youkai?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Mondstadt doesn't have anything like youkai. Is this your first time here?

Yup! Fortunately for me, the company I work for's been expanding, so I'm now getting the opportunity to travel to cities all over Teyvat. ...Oh! It's been such a pleasure chatting with you that I almost lost track of time! I'd better get going, or I'll be late for my next customer!
Diona of the Kätzlein Clan, your pick-up is complete. Thank you for choosing Komaniya Express!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Great. Feel free to come hang out any time!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hmm... Do only youkai have tails in Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Diona!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Oh, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Hey, what brings you back to Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we figured it'd been a while since we visited The Cat's Tail, so we thought we'd come and say hi! Oh, and by the way — who was that just now?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Oh, she's a courier from Komaniya Express. They're an international delivery service operating out of Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is The Cat's Tail doing international business now!?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: No, no, no, no. A customer left some goods with us and arranged for Komaniya Express to pick them up, that's all. I didn't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: You've been to Inazuma, right? Did you... see lots of youkai like her there?

choices.text: We saw some with wings on their back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! But this is actually the first time we've ever seen one with two tails.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Wooow... I'd love to go see for myself one day... Hmm. Anyway, what were you two here for again? Did you need me for something?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, Paimon almost forgot. Do you know anything about a Genius Invokation TCG tournament? Apparently there's prizes and stuff!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: A tournament? Oh, you must mean the one being organized by the Adventurers' Guild. It's a pretty big event. They even had posters imported from Inazuma.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: But I'm busy with things here, so I didn't sign up. I don't know all the details... Maybe try asking my boss.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it. Well, with any luck we'll win some Mora, and then we'll treat you to some yummy food!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Hmph! Whaddya you mean, "luck"? I'm the one who taught you how to play, after all!

choices.text: Thanks, Coach.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: That's meow like it! Okay, you two should probably get going now. Head to the fountain plaza — my boss usually takes a walk around there at this time of day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, we'll go there right away.

choices.text: We'll make you proud.
And others with fox ears.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Margaret! We thought we might find you here.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: #Oh, if it isn't {NICKNAME} and Paimon! It's been a while, hasn't it? Lemme guess — back to play some cards?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... It's not like we only ever come back to Mondstadt to play cards...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Oh, really? I just assumed you were here to take part in the King of Invokations Grand Prix.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: King of Invokations Grand Prix...? Oh, that must be the Adventurers' Guild one that Diona mentioned.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, that's the one. Genius Invokation TCG has been attracting more and more players lately.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: The Adventurers' Guild arranged for venues in every city to hold a regional tournament for the King of Invokations Grand Prix. The rewards are quite substantial.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Mondstadt is already at the finals stage, so I'm afraid you might be a little too late to get that prize...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Darn... We already promised Diona we'd treat her to some food with the Mora we won...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: It's alright! There's bound to be a next time. This card game came out of nowhere and has already taken the world by storm... Who knows where it'll go next?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: The game's creators must be ecstatic with all this success, don't you think? It's unbelievably popular.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. And it only gets more fun the more people there are to play it with.

choices.text: I really want to play now...

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Well... You may have missed the boat on the official event, but there's also an unofficial tourney organized by some players. Would that interest you at all?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Unofficial tourney?

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: That's right. With all the excitement surrounding the main tournament, players can hardly contain their enthusiasm. So they've set up an unofficial tourney aimed at a larger player base.

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: You can sign up at any time and play however many matches you want. They even have pre-built decks for players to use. Oh, and the rewards are pretty generous, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon likes the sound of this! Thanks for the info, Margaret. We'll go check it out!

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: You're welcome. There are plenty of booths at the venue offering food and other fun activities, so it's definitely worth a visit. Who knows, you might even bump into some old friends there.

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Right, if there's nothing else you needed, I'll be continuing my walk now.

choices.text: I want to win that tournament...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Paimon still thinks that with your abilities, winning the grand prize in the official tournament would have been as easy as pie!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just imagine it: "Honorary Knight Defeats Foes and Emerges as Tournament Champion"! The headline practically writes itself.
Hmm? Do my ears deceive me... Or do you two have some breaking news to share with me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Wh—Who are you? And why the heck are you eavesdropping on us!?
Ah, sorry — force of habit! I tend to keep my ears peeled at all times... Didn't even realize I was listening in.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Let me introduce myself. I'm Charlotte, a reporter for The Steambird from Fontaine. I've been posted here to cover the King of Invokations Grand Prix.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Steambird?

choices.text: Sounds familiar.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: The Steambird is a major news outlet headquartered in Fontaine and widely acclaimed all over Teyvat. We even have regular columnists based right here in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ooh, okay. Paimon's name is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}. What was that you were saying about some breaking news?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Oh, looks like I've managed to pique your interest. Well, the truth is that my keen reporting senses are telling me that this competition will be chock-full of huge news stories!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huge news stories? You sure your senses are reliable...?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Absolutely! After all... I've seen it with my own eyes! There's a criminal who's been slinking around the competition venue, and his name is the Card Snatcher!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Card Snatcher?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Mm-hmm. He stole his opponent's cards when they weren't looking. I was about to try and chase him down, but the next moment, he'd disappeared into thin air.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But why would someone wanna steal other people's cards?

choices.text: Maybe to gain an edge over his opponents?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Hehe, whatever the truth of the matter — it's my job as a journalist to dig up all the gory details and turn them into my very own exclusive news piece!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: So, what do you think? Wanna join me in my quest to uncover the sensational story that's hiding behind the scenes?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That does sound interesting, but... why us? Any reason you singled us out in particular...?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Are you kidding me?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: It's a no-brainer, considering you're the Honorary Knight who saved Mondstadt, the hero of Liyue who fought alongside the adepti, a key player in the repealing of Inazuma's Sakoku Decree, and the redeemer of the Sumeru Akademiya...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay, point taken... Yeah, it seems like we've ended up making quite a big name for ourselves, huh.

choices.text: She really did her homework...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, kinda scary... Does she research all her new friends before meeting them for the first time?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I promise you, teaming up with me will be a great move for you. For starters, when my exclusive news article is published, you'll be credited as contributors.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Not to mention that being in a news agency makes me pretty well-connected. That'll come in real handy if you're ever traveling in Fontaine. And if you ever wanted to run an ad in the paper one day, no problem. I could make that happen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That actually sounds genuinely useful... What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Why not? We've got some time on our hands.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Great, then welcome to the news crew! Ah, I've heard that the Traveler always lends a helping hand, so it's nice to know that you live up to your reputation... but even nicer to experience it for myself.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Now then. Before we start investigating our card snatcher, I have one other small task to take care of first.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: That Mondstadt columnist who I mentioned earlier is a long-time favorite of The Steambird's readership. Management thought that a cash bonus was in order, so I brought it along with me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so we're gonna go meet them now?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Yep, I have the address right here. We just need to make a slight detour to drop off the Mora, then we'll be on our way.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Heh... I thought you would have figured out who it is I'm talking about by now. From what I've heard, you're quite well acquainted.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it's someone we know? Hmm, that doesn't narrow it down much — we know lots of people in Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, never mind. Just lead the way, Charlotte.

choices.text: And this "Card Snatcher" sounds interesting.
Let's hear some more of our accomplishments...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, we've got better things to do than listening to that!

choices.text: Perhaps he just wants to throw off the other competitors?
Never heard of it.

talks.objective: Follow Charlotte to the columnist's address

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Here we are! Wait here a moment, I'll go hand over the cash.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, so it's...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #Who is it? Can I help you? ...Oh, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, what brings you here? And... I'm sorry, I don't believe we've...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: You must be Mona Megistus, the Astrologist. It's an honor to finally meet you.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I'm Charlotte, a reporter from The Steambird. Your columns have been so well-received by our readers lately that our management asked me to present you with this cash bonus.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She got Mona's full name and title right on her first try... She really does do her homework!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ah, you must be Charlotte? Welcome, welcome... Please, just call me Mona. Gosh, this is a long way to come from Fontaine. I hope it wasn't too much trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: No trouble at all. It was on the way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, sounds like your articles are a real hit with readers all over Teyvat, Mona!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm? Have I never told you? I've been writing my column "All Things Astrological" for The Steambird for a long time now.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: The chief editor wrote to me a while ago about the bonus. Thank goodness it's finally here, I was wondering when it would arrive. Thank you, Charlotte...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Huh, you make it sound like you really needed this... Are you pressed for money, Mona?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: What? No, of course not! It's just that once I knew the bonus was coming, I re-allocated some funds that I'd previously set aside for daily necessities, and purchased some expensive equipment... That's all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, classic Mona...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Aha, perfect! "Renowned Astrologist Broke and Starving — Do the Stars Really Have All the Answers?" ...The article practically writes itself!

choices.text: Actually, that does sound like an interesting read.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: ...Aw! I beg your pardon!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mona's actually super rich — it's just that astrology research is really expensive.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: #"Super rich" is a bit of a stretch... Ugh, anyway, enough about that. What brings you back to Mondstadt this time, {NICKNAME} and Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Originally, we just came to catch up with a friend of ours... but some things have come up, and now we're helping Charlotte investigate the case of the Card Snatcher.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Speaking of which, will you be competing in the King of Invokations Grand Prix? Word is that the prizes are pretty stellar.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I'm much too busy with my research these days to dedicate time to a competition. Besides, even if I did enter, there's no guarantee I'd actually win a prize, is there?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Isn't there? I'd have thought you'd be certain to win with astrology on your side. You'd know all of your opponents' cards ahead of time.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: What do you take me for? No self-respecting astrologist would dream of abusing their beloved art for such crude purposes. Besides, it wouldn't be fair to the other contestants.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Well said. Spoken like an accomplished academic and a conscientious citizen.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Well yes, obviously. Anyway, if past precedent is anything to go by, you're the ones who ought to be wary of what's around the corner. Especially if you're chasing after this... Card Snatcher, was it? Sounds like bad news — shall I take a glance at what you're up against?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Thanks for the offer, but there's no need. Relying on your astrological skills for all the juicy details would make this story a Mona-exclusive... but that's not quite the kind of exclusive report I'm going for here.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: But don't you worry — they call it "investigative journalism" for a reason... We journos have our ways!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Alright. Well, best of luck with your investigation then. Thanks again for bringing the bonus, Charlotte. Do give my regards to the chief editor.

choices.text: Take care of yourself, Mona...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I will — and yes, we should. I'll hold you to that.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I think it's about time we started heading to the competition venue. The Mondstadt regional final should be starting shortly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! Paimon can't wait to find out who the finalists are.

choices.text: ...Also, we should play another game of Genius Invokation TCG sometime!
Sounds a little exaggerated, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, so this is the venue, huh? Seems pretty lively here!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Well, if it isn't {NICKNAME} and Paimon. What a rare surprise. Did you really come all this way just to watch Timmie and me in the final?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kaeya? You made it to the finals? Wait... What about your work with the Knights of Favonius? You'd better not be slacking off again...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hey, c'mon now. That's no way to talk to a friend. Naturally, I wouldn't have considered entering the competition were I not already on top of my work.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ah, enjoying a drink while playing a few rounds of cards... I can't think of a better way to relax outside of work, can you? Oh, just be sure not to tell Diona I said that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, since you're in the competition... Have you noticed anything suspicious going on so far? You know, like... people stealing other players' cards, that kind of thing?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Stealing cards, you say? I'm afraid I haven't seen anything of that sort — not while I've been playing, anyway. Why do you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we just ran into this journalist from Fontaine, and she... Huh? Where'd Charlotte go? She was right here, wasn't she...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Grr... Paimon bets she snuck off to go find some tasty snacks for herself!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Journalist from Fontaine... Oh, you mean the one from The Steambird? I do recall seeing a Steambird reporter listed in the Knights of Favonius' visitor log.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that'll be her. She said that she saw a Card Snatcher at the tournament venue, so we're helping her investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: A "Card Snatcher"? ...Hmm, how very interesting. But, one question, Paimon... Are you sure that cards are really what this "snatcher" is after?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What makes you say that?

dialogues.speaker: Master of Ceremonies
dialogues.text: Hello everyone, your attention please! The final is about to begin! Now, let's give a warm welcome to our two contestants!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Guess we'll have to leave it there. Let's continue this conversation another time.

choices.text: Good luck, Kaeya!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Thanks, Traveler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Go get 'em, Kaeya! We'll see you in a bit!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So {NICKNAME}, who do you think's gonna win?

choices.text: Pretty sure Timmie will win.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Timmie seems to be a pretty strong TCG player.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Either way, whoever wins is bound to make headlines... Wait, speaking of headlines, isn't that Charlotte's job!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... maybe she got caught up trying out all the delicious Mondstadt snacks? Let's go look for her.

choices.text: I think Kaeya will win.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Kaeya's quite the crafty one. He must have some tricks up his sleeve.

choices.text: Give it your best!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Don't worry, I will.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Charlotte! What happened? You just disappeared without saying anything!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Oh, I just didn't want to bother you while you were catching up with your friend.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Kaeya's one of the finalists. Don't you wanna interview him, or something? You did say you're supposed to be covering the competition...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Ehh, I could churn out that kind of soft news piece in five minutes if I had to. Personally... I'm more interested in those two.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: From the moment things kicked off, they've been acting very strangely, like they're trying to stay out of sight... I'm sure they must be plotting something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? *gasp* You mean, there are two Card Snatchers!?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Shh! Keep your voice down! We don't want to scare them off! We need to wait until we've got something concrete, then we can use my Kamera to catch them in the act...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Huh!? Wait, where'd the other guy go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's on the run!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: After him!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: He's heading towards Mondstadt's side gate. Let's follow him, but quietly. We mustn't let him spot us.

talks.objective: Go to the side gate and follow the suspicious person

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now he's heading away from the city. How long are we gonna follow him for?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, at this rate, we're going to miss Kaeya and Timmie's match.

talks.objective: Go past the city gate and follow the suspicious person

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Ah, there — looks like he's stopped. Let's sit tight and see what happens.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why'd he come all the way out here? Is he gonna hide something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And now he's crouching down with his hands above his head... Wait, Treasure Hoarders! He's in trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Quick, we need to rescue him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: Oh thank goodness! I thought it was all over for me.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Those Treasure Hoarders, did you know them? It sure looked like they were here just for you.

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: Why would I know them!? I was just... uh, out for a walk. Minding my own business, and then the next thing I knew, I was surrounded!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Oh, really? Then why did they target you? It wouldn't be because of some dubious deal you were involved in at the tournament, would it?

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: Huh? A deal? I, uh... I don't know what you're talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Well that's a shame. You see, I'm a journalist, and I just happened to snap a picture of you and one other individual in the middle of a deal back at the tournament.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I was only going to ask you for an interview, but that was before you caused all this trouble... and now you're feigning ignorance of the deal in question...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe I'm just wasting my time? Shall I just cut my losses and hand over the evidence to the Knights of Favonius?

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: Whoa whoa whoa, no, please! I'll talk! But you gotta believe me, there's nothing shady going on, I swear!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that was some serious bluffing on Charlotte's part... she didn't take any pictures at all.

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: Back at the tournament, I was approached by some random guy who said that he wanted to buy a card back off me. I said, okay, how much are you offering... and when he told me the amount, my jaw practically hit the floor!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Really? What kind of card back was it?

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: Uhh... Nothing special, I just picked it up at a general goods store. It had a treasure chest design on it. I only bought it because it was dirt cheap.

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: This guy offered me three times what I'd paid for it, and handed me the Mora right then and there.

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: I could hardly believe my luck, so I decided to head somewhere less crowded and check the Mora was real. That's when I ran into the Treasure Hoarders...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Did you ask him why he wanted to purchase this item from you?

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: No, I didn't... Genius Invokation TCG has been getting pretty popular lately, and some people will pay good Mora to make their decks look flashy. It didn't strike me as that unusual.

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: But after I gave him the card back, he let out a sigh of relief and said something about, uh... "That's all the Mondstadt ones. Next stop, Liyue," or something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: ..."Or something like that"? He either said that or he didn't, how certain are you?

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: I'm positive! I know what I heard. Once the card was in his hands, he suddenly relaxed, like a huge burden had been taken off his shoulders. It was genuine relief! ...Could that card back really be as valuable as he thought?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: That I don't know. But in the interests of your personal safety, I suggest you report all of this to the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: After all, you weren't doing anything against the law, were you?

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: Right, yeah, no, that makes sense. I'll go speak to the Knights of Favonius right away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It sounds like that guy's just collecting rare card backs. Are you sure this is the person you're after, Charlotte?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Well, it definitely doesn't add up. You really think someone out there's going from nation to nation shelling out huge sums of money for a few card backs bought from a grocery store?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: My gut tells me that there's more to this story than the card back alone. Hehe, this entire situation reeks of exclusive news!

choices.text: Do you think there's real treasure involved?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, treasure! Maybe the card backs make a treasure map? You know, collect all the pieces, put 'em together, and they reveal where the treasure is buried!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Who knows... but wherever this leads, we're definitely onto something.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Even though I didn't manage to get a good look at his face, his physique and the way he moved were identical to the Card Snatcher I saw last time. I'm sure it's the same guy.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: He was much more discreet this time, though. I guess he didn't want to risk trying anything with so many potential witnesses around.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From the sounds of it, we need to head to Liyue next, right? Paimon can't wait — we have tons of friends in Liyue, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But shouldn't we check in with Kaeya before we leave? Paimon at least wants to find out who won the final.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Good idea, let's go.

choices.text: Maybe it was designed by a famous artist?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you mean someone like Albedo? Hmm, that would explain why only some people understand the true value.

dialogues.speaker: Master of Ceremonies
dialogues.text: I hereby declare the winner of the Mondstadt regional final of the King of Invokations Grand Prix is... Timmie!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Timmie won, that's amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: *sigh* I was beaten by the best. Timmie's a tough opponent — he had me on the back foot the entire time.

choices.text: There's always next time.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Haha, it's alright, you don't need to comfort me.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: This must be the journalist from Fontaine you mentioned earlier. Charlotte, was it? Enchantée.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'm Kaeya, Cavalry Captain of the Knights of Favonius. I trust you're enjoying your time in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: The pleasure is all mine. Mondstadt's reputation as the City of Song and Freedom is truly deserved. The mood here is simply delightful.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Haha, I'm glad you're liking it. By the way, I couldn't help but notice you all rushing towards the city's side gate earlier. Did you find something? I couldn't get it off my mind, even during the competition.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Kaeya everything that happened...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hmm, I see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So it seems we have an answer to Kaeya's question from earlier: What the Card Snatcher's really after is these card backs. But we still haven't figured out why he cares so much about them.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hmm. Well, while I'd love to accompany you all to Liyue Harbor, I'm afraid I still have my Knights of Favonius duties to attend to.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: In fact, our top priority right now is strengthening Mondstadt's defenses. Treasure Hoarder activity has been increasingly rampant lately.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, don't worry, we'll keep you in the loop if we find anything. In fact, if Charlotte's journalistic instinct is on point, you'll probably be reading her exclusive report in The Steambird before long!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Wonderful. Then I look forward to reading all about it.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Haha, thanks for supporting quality journalism. Okay, let's take tonight off and head to Liyue Harbor tomorrow. It'll give me a chance to write down everything that's happened today.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon wanted to ask... See the two people on this poster? Are they the inventors of Genius Invokation TCG? They look so young!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Maybe, but very little is known about either of them.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Whether they've been living under a rock this whole time or just aren't interested in the fame, I don't know. But hardly anybody has ever seen them.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The poster's probably just an artist's impression to capture the general look and feel of the duo. Beyond that, I doubt it's very true to life.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sound like they're a couple of socially reclusive scholars. If Paimon were in their shoes, she'd be showing up to all the events, signing autographs, selling cards... and probably getting complimentary food and drink!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Haha, I approve. And to top it off, you could play a few rounds of Genius Invokation with everyone.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I was reading up on the game's inventors before I came to Mondstadt. I was originally hoping to arrange an interview with them.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: But I soon discovered that there's no mention anywhere of where they live or of any Genius Invokation events that they've attended.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: It's as if they designed the game and then never played it again.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What a mysterious couple of game designers.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Either they don't want to play the game, or they're unable to. But they must have their reasons.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I wonder if they'll show up at all during the King of Invokations Grand Prix...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: #Maybe, if you get lucky... and based on my experience, {NICKNAME} seems to have no shortage of that.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Oh really? Well, that gives me one less thing to worry about.

choices.text: Hearing that that put you at ease puts me at ease.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Anyway, our focus is still on tracking down the Card Snatcher.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I heard Snezhnaya has an old saying: "If you try chasing two rabbits at once, you'll only end up empty-handed."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well... {NICKNAME} and Paimon can always split up and chase one rabbit each!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, now Paimon's feeling hungry. We can worry about all this later — right now, it's time to get some grub.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Haha... You can always trust Paimon to know where life's priorities lie. If it's food you're after, I recommend taking a look at the nearby stalls.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The tournament has brought quite a crowd, so there's a lot of fun to be had around the venue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds great! Thanks, Kaeya!

choices.text: Hopefully my luck won't run out any time soon...
At least you are gracious in defeat.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: I'm bringing my A-game today, and I'm gonna win this thing!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Everyone's quite fired up... Whew, it's even making me a little nervous.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: You've got this, Captain Kaeya! The Knights of Favonius are counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Lennard
dialogues.text: I sure hope Timmie wins the finals... At least then, I could say I lost to the champion...

dialogues.speaker: Eichendorff
dialogues.text: I understand where you're coming from, but don't get your hopes up. It's gonna be tough for him to beat the Cavalry Captain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been a while since we last played cards at The Cat's Tail... Wonder how Diona's doing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, since we have some time on our hands, let's go check up on her!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, who could it be?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: One of your rich friends, I'd assume. After all, you gotta be pretty well-off to live in the city, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That still doesn't really narrow it down... We know lots of people with lots of Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Wow... I guess being a national hero earns you friends in high places...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... You seem like you've done this before. Do you spy on people often?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Haha, you're too kind. You should see the celebrities in Fontaine — the lengths they'll go to to try and avoid the public eye... Compared to that, this is nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That wasn't supposed to be a compliment!

dialogues.speaker: Adrian
dialogues.text: Help! Someone save me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are the Treasure Hoarders doing so close to the city?
